title: 同时保持两种运算
Preserving both operations
text: 环同态同时保持加法与乘法。双射同态称同构。依本教材约定，同态不额外要求保持单位元；例如零映射也是环同态。
A ring homomorphism preserves addition and multiplication; a bijective one is an isomorphism. This textbook does not require homomorphisms to preserve identity, so the zero map is allowed.
example: ℤ→ℤₙ 的取余映射和 R→R/I 的自然映射都是满同态。反例：ℤ→ℤ，a↦2a 保持加法，却因 2≠4 不保持 1·1。
Reduction ℤ→ℤₙ and the projection R→R/I are surjective homomorphisms. The map a↦2a on ℤ preserves addition but not 1·1.

title: 哪些元素一定被保持？
What does a homomorphism preserve?
text: 同态保持零、整数倍与正整数次幂。对有单位元的环之间的同态：满射时保持 1；目标无零因子且 φ(1)≠0 时也保持 1；一旦保持 1，就保持可逆元及其逆。

Homomorphisms preserve zero, integer multiples and positive powers. Between unital rings, a surjective homomorphism preserves 1, as does one into a ring without zero-divisors with φ(1)≠0. A homomorphism preserving 1 preserves units and inverses.
proof: 加法群同态给出零、负元与整数倍；乘法归纳给出正整数次幂。
The additive group homomorphism gives zero, negatives and integer multiples; induction gives positive powers.
若满射，对任意 y=φ(x)，φ(1)y=φ(x)=yφ(1)。因此 φ(1) 是目标单位元。
If surjective, φ(1)y=yφ(1)=y for every y=φ(x), so φ(1) is the target identity.
The image φ(1) is idempotent. With no zero-divisors and φ(1)≠0, φ(1)(φ(1)−1)=0 forces φ(1)=1.
若保 1，对 uu⁻¹=u⁻¹u=1 应用 φ，即见 φ(u⁻¹) 是 φ(u) 的双侧逆。
When 1 is preserved, apply φ to uu⁻¹=u⁻¹u=1 to obtain the inverse.
warning: 嵌入 ℤ→ℤ×ℤ，a↦(a,0) 不把 1 映到 (1,1)，却仍是教材意义下的单同态。
The embedding a↦(a,0) from ℤ to ℤ×ℤ does not send 1 to (1,1), but is a homomorphism in this convention.

title: 核正是被压成零的理想
The kernel is an ideal
text: 环同态的核是源环的理想。单射当且仅当核为零；像是目标的子环，但一般不是目标的理想。
The kernel is an ideal of the source ring. A homomorphism is injective exactly when its kernel is zero. Its image is a subring of the target, but need not be an ideal.
proof: 0 在核中。若 a,b 在核中，则 φ(a−b)=0；对任意 r，φ(ra)=φ(r)φ(a)=0，φ(ar)=0。
Zero lies in the kernel, as do a−b, ra and ar whenever a,b are in it.
φ(a)=φ(b) 当且仅当 a−b∈kerφ，因此零核等价于单射。
The equality φ(a)=φ(b) is equivalent to a−b∈kerφ, giving the injectivity criterion.
像对差与积封闭，故为子环；包含映射 ℤ→ℚ 的像不是 ℚ 的理想。
The image is closed under differences and products. The image of ℤ→ℚ is not an ideal of ℚ.

title: 环同态基本定理
The first isomorphism theorem
text: 任何环同态都分解为“取商，再嵌入”。教材定理 3.4.4 写成满同态的情形；一般情形把目标换成像即可。
Every ring homomorphism factors as a quotient followed by an embedding. The textbook states Theorem 3.4.4 for a surjective map; the general case uses its image as target.
proof: 令 K=kerφ。若 a+K=b+K，则 a−b∈K，所以 φ(a)=φ(b)，映射良定义。
Let K=kerφ. Equal cosets differ by an element of K, so they have equal images.
用商环运算及 φ 保运算，得到诱导映射同时保持加法与乘法。
The quotient operations and the homomorphism identities give preservation of both operations.
它满射到 imφ；若两像相同，则 a−b∈K，故原陪集相同。因此也是单射。
It surjects onto imφ. Equal images imply a−b∈K and hence equal cosets, so it is injective.

title: 把未定元代成一个数
Evaluation turns relations into kernels
text: 代入映射 f↦f(√2) 保持加法与乘法，像为 ℚ[√2]，核是 (x²−2)。这一例子把“强制 x²=2”变成精确的商环构造。
Evaluation f↦f(√2) preserves both operations, has image ℚ[√2], and kernel (x²−2). The quotient makes the relation x²=2 precise.
proof: 多项式的和与积在代入后仍是对应值的和与积；每个 a+b√2 都是 a+bx 的像。
Evaluation preserves sums and products. Every a+b√2 is the image of a+bx.
在 ℚ[x] 中带余除以 x²−2，写 f=q(x²−2)+ax+b。该带余算法将在 §4.4 证明。
Divide in ℚ[x] to write f=q(x²−2)+ax+b; the division algorithm is proved in §4.4.
若 f(√2)=0，则 a√2+b=0。√2 无理迫使 a=b=0，故核恰为 (x²−2)。
If f(√2)=0, irrationality forces a=b=0. Thus the kernel is exactly (x²−2).
应用环同态基本定理即得同构。
Apply the first isomorphism theorem.

title: 两个常用的同构定理
Two further isomorphism theorems
text: 第一式中 S 是 R 的子环、I 是 R 的理想。第二式中 I⊆J 都是 R 的理想。选对自然映射，再求核，通常比直接比较陪集更清楚。
In the first formula S is a subring and I an ideal of R. In the second I⊆J are ideals of R. Choose the natural map and compute its kernel.

label: 例 8 · 习题 3-4 第 20 题
Example 8 · Exercise 3-4 No. 20

proof: 映射 S→(S+I)/I，s↦s+I 满射，因为 (s+i)+I=s+I；核为 S∩I。
The map S→(S+I)/I, s↦s+I, is surjective with kernel S∩I.
映射 R/I→R/J，a+I↦a+J 因 I⊆J 而良定义，显然满射，核为 J/I。
The map R/I→R/J, a+I↦a+J, is well-defined because I⊆J, is surjective, and has kernel J/I.
分别应用同态基本定理得到两个结论，同时核的性质说明相应商理想合法。
Apply the first isomorphism theorem to each map; the kernel property also supplies the necessary ideals.

title: 挖补定理：把嵌入改写为包含
Transporting structure along an embedding
text: 设 S、R 的底集合不交且 φ:S→R 为单同态。可把 R 中的 φ(S) 改名为 S，得到含 S 为子环的环 R̃，并有延拓 φ 的同构 R̃→R。
For disjoint underlying sets and an embedding φ:S→R, replace φ(S) inside R by S. The resulting ring R̃ contains S as an actual subring and is isomorphic to R by an extension of φ.
proof: 取集合 R̃=(R∖φ(S))∪S。令 f 在 S 上为 φ，在其余元素上为恒等映射；它是到 R 的双射。
Take R̃=(R∖φ(S))∪S and let f equal φ on S and the identity elsewhere. It is a bijection onto R.
定义 x⊕y=f⁻¹(f(x)+f(y))、x⊙y=f⁻¹(f(x)f(y))，把 R 的运算搬回 R̃。
Define x⊕y=f⁻¹(f(x)+f(y)) and x⊙y=f⁻¹(f(x)f(y)), transporting the operations.
每条环公理经 f 化为 R 中的公理。因 φ 保运算，限制在 S 上恰为 S 原有的运算。
Every ring axiom becomes the corresponding axiom in R under f. Since φ preserves operations, the restriction to S agrees with its original structure.
warning: 底集合不交只是避免重名；必要时先给元素加标签。此定理不声称 R 本来就按集合包含 S。
Disjointness only avoids naming collisions; tagged copies suffice. The theorem does not claim the original R literally contains S.

title: 给一个无单位元的环添加单位元
Adjoining an identity
text: 对任意环 R，ℤ⊕R 配分量加法与上式乘法成为有单位元的环，单位元为 (1,0)，a↦(0,a) 给出嵌入。
For any ring R, ℤ⊕R with componentwise addition and the displayed multiplication is unital, with identity (1,0). The map a↦(0,a) embeds R.
proof: 分配律直接展开；结合律的第二分量在两种括号下均为 nmc+nℓb+mℓa+ℓab+nbc+mac+abc。
Distribute directly. For three factors (n,a),(m,b),(ℓ,c), both associations have second component nmc+nℓb+mℓa+ℓab+nbc+mac+abc.
Multiplication by (1,0) on either side fixes (n,a).
(0,a)(0,b)=(0,ab)，且加法也保持；映射 a↦(0,a) 显然单射。
The inclusion preserves both operations, since (0,a)(0,b)=(0,ab), and is injective.

question: 按教材约定，哪一个 ℤ→ℤ 映射是环同态？
Which map ℤ→ℤ is a ring homomorphism under the textbook convention?
reason: 零映射同时保持两种运算；其余映射分别不保加法或乘法。
The zero map preserves both operations. The other maps fail additivity or multiplicativity.

question: 取余同态 ℤ→ℤ₅ 的核是？
What is the kernel of reduction ℤ→ℤ₅?
reason: 所有且仅有 5 的整数倍映为零。
Exactly the integer multiples of 5 map to zero.

question: φ:R→S 不要求满射时，正确的一般结论是？
Without surjectivity, which is the general isomorphism theorem?
reason: 必须以像为目标；满射时像才等于 S。
The target must be the image, which equals S only for a surjection.

question: a↦(a,0) 从 ℤ 到 ℤ×ℤ 是哪一种映射？
What kind of map is a↦(a,0) from ℤ to ℤ×ℤ?
options: 不保目标 1 的单同态
reason: 它保加法与乘法且单射，但把 1 送到 (1,0) 而不是 (1,1)。
It preserves both operations and is injective, but sends 1 to (1,0), not (1,1).

question: 对域 F，证明代入映射 F[x]→F，f↦f(a) 的核为 (x−a)，从而得到一个商环同构。
For a field F, find the kernel of evaluation f↦f(a) and the resulting quotient isomorphism.
reason: 代入保两种运算，常数多项式保证满射。带余除法给出 f=(x−a)q+r，r∈F；代入 a 得 r=f(a)。因此核为 (x−a)，同态基本定理给出 F[x]/(x−a)≅F。
Evaluation preserves both operations and is surjective via constants. Division gives f=(x−a)q+r with r=f(a), so the kernel is (x−a). Thus F[x]/(x−a)≅F.
